messages:
alex: FYI — GPUs showing anomalous queueing and our weekly burn report spiked for eu-west around 03:22 UTC. Anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: ALERT: gpu_queue_high (severity=page) cluster=eu-west-1 rate=0.21 (>0.15) for 9m — https://grafana.redwood.local/d/fleet/fleet-overview

sam: I see repeated kubelet evictions and pod OOMs on gpu-pool-9. Node autoscaler kept failing due to cloud quota errors. Logs: "Failed to create node: quota exceeded".

mira: Our SLI currently uses a 5m smoothing window: `sum(rate(gpu_queue_length[5m])) / sum(gpu_capacity_total)`. That makes the weekly export very spiky. Suggest switching to avg_over_time and grouping by region.

alex: We should tune alerts rather than silence them. Proposal: change prom window -> 20m, alert `for` -> 25m, and filter `env="prod"` so noisy batch jobs don't count.

lee: I'll draft PRs: `/ops/alerts/gpu_burn.yaml` and `/ops/exports/burn_exporter.sh`. For the export I will add a compatibility flag so existing consumers (analytics team) can still read v1 CSV.

sam: Two warnings: 1) analytics errorbudget calc depends on the window; we'll need to rebaseline ~90d of history after the change. 2) too much smoothing hides 30m sustained degradation.

mira: Suggested PromQL tweak: 
```promql
# per-region smoothed production queue ratio
sum by(region)(avg_over_time(gpu_queue_length{env="prod"}[20m]))
/ sum by(region)(gpu_capacity_total{env="prod"})
```
Also add a label filter `job!~"batch-runner|ad-hoc"` to exclude noisy non-prod traffic.

alex: Can we add a Grafana stat panel for "remaining error budget" per-region plus a 6h sparkline for recent burn? That would help oncall triage before pages escalate.

jen: +1. Also add an annotation to the export job when we roll this change so historical comparisons are annotated.

lee: Opening PRs now. I'll update the alert rule to `for: 25m` and change the exporter to use 20m smoothing by default, with a `--legacy` flag to keep old behavior. Will add migration notes in /ops/notes and update runbook.

deploy-bot: CONFIG-CHANGE: PR #452 merged to staging -> /ops/alerts/gpu_burn.yaml (for: 25m). CI: passed.

alex: Thanks. After deploy, let's run a dry-run of the exporter against the last 7 days and compare the delta. Who can own the dry-run?

sam: I'll run the dry-run and post diffs here by EOD.

mira: One more: add a suppression so nodes labelled `no_sli=true` or clusters with `sli_exempt=true` are excluded from the aggregated metrics. Helps test infra and stress jobs not to pollute SLI.

alex: Agreed. Thanks team :thumbsup:

(also created a short follow-up to update the weekly errorbudget notebook to annotate when smoothing params changed)
